map.Cohen's d 效应量计算器：输入两组均值与合并标准差，求 d 效应量衡量差: Cohen's d effect size calculator: enter the two group means and the pooled standard deviation to get the d effect size measuring the magnitude of the difference, for assessing comparability of experimental results.
map.Cohen's d 用两组均值之差除以合并标准差 s_p，得到以标准差为单位的效: Cohen's d divides the difference between the two group means by the pooled standard deviation s_p, giving an effect size in standard deviation units that removes the original dimension and makes effect magnitudes comparable across experiments: |d| around 0.2 is small, 0.5 medium and 0.8 large. s_p is obtained by weighting the two variances by sample size.
map.d = (m₁ − m₂) / s_p；s_p 为合并标准差: d = (m₁ − m₂) / s_p; s_p is the pooled standard deviation
map.d 效应量计算器 使用指南: d effect size calculator user guide
map.p 值受样本量影响（大样本小差异也显著），效应量 d 衡量差异幅度，二者互补。: The p value depends on sample size (a small difference becomes significant in a large sample), while the effect size d measures the magnitude of the difference, so the two complement each other.
map.sp=√(((n1−1)s1²+(n2−1)s2²)/(n1+n2−2))，即: sp=√(((n1−1)s1²+(n2−1)s2²)/(n1+n2−2)), the square root of the pooled variance.
